references.evidence_scope: Publisher and author-institution abstract records; no full text obtained
references.supported_context: Classical contacting-wedge models can have logarithmic pressure terms; rounding and profile-gradient assumptions matter.

references.title: Tangential-displacement effects in the wedge indentation of an elastic half-space – an integral-equation approach
references.author: H. G. Georgiadis
references.supported_context: In a two-dimensional frictionless linear-elastic wedge formulation, including tangential surface displacement in contact kinematics removes the classical apex singularity.

inference_for_current_case: The measured90-degree finger feature and growing raw/discrete maxima warrant further diagnosis, not a blanket singularity declaration. Neither abstract proves the asymptotic behavior of the current finite3D frictional neo-Hookean/barrier problem.
